description: Adverse Decision Stage: Application refused by Executive Committee. Statutory Clause 2.24(a) allows applicant to appeal once to Council within strictly 7 calendar days of decision upload.

entryPrerequisites.description: Speaking Order of Rejection uploaded with timestamp.

allowedTransitions.buttonLabel: File Statutory Appeal to SAC (Within 7 Days)
validationRules: Appeal must be submitted within strictly 7 calendar days of decision upload (NOW() <= decision_uploaded_at + 7 days at 23:59:59 UTC)
Proof of payment of statutory appeal fee must be attached
Grounds of appeal and point-by-point rebuttal must be submitted
7 calendar days elapsed since decision upload timestamp without appeal submission
Administrative appeal rights permanently barred by limitation

timePolicy.description: Statutory Appeal Limitation: Aggrieved applicant may appeal once to Council within exactly 7 calendar days from portal upload date.

exitConditions.description: Appeal filed in time or case permanently barred by limitation.
verificationCriteria: appeal_filed_at is not null or appeal_exhausted == true
